name: Arman Holdings Limited
about: Arman Holdings Limited engages in the trading of textiles, precious metals, and stones in India. It operates through three segments: Textile Products, Precious Metal & Stones, and Plastic Products. The company engages in the trading, exporting, importing, wholesaling, exhibiting, buying, and selling of precious stones, chemicals, textiles, paper, oil, cement, plastic, automobile, jute, tea, sugar, gold, diamonds, ferrous and nonferrous metals, electronic goods and handicrafts, and other products. It also offers grey, knitted, fancy, cotton, polyester, and linen fabrics. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Surat, India.
